customSections.label: What West Ada Families Should Know
customSections.content: These grade-level differences and changes from 2026–27 are easy to miss in the district file.

definitions.description: Grades K–8 have no school September 24. The official calendar does not list grades 9–12 as off that day.

definitions.term: October conferences differ by grade level
definitions.description: October 6 is an evening conference date for K–12. On October 7, grades K–8 have no school for parent-teacher conferences, while grades 9–12 remain in session and hold evening conferences. October 8 is no school for all grades.
West Ada specifically labels April 14, 2028 as a Working Calendar Adjustment with no school for all grades.

definitions.term: August 11 is not labeled as a late start
definitions.description: Unlike the 2026–27 calendar, the reviewed 2027–28 PDF does not identify the first day as a late-start day.

customSections.label: Why This Page Uses December 31, 2027 for Winter Break
customSections.content:
The official PDF prints Winter Break as December 20, 2027 through December 31, 2028. On the same calendar, January 3, 2028 is a teacher prep day and students return January 4.

Because those January dates immediately follow Winter Break, this page uses December 31, 2027 as the internally consistent end date. The official PDF’s conflicting year is documented here rather than silently corrected.

If West Ada publishes a revised 2027–28 calendar, the revised district file should replace this interpretation.

customSections.label: 2027–28 Calendar Files
customSections.content:
When this page was reviewed on August 11, 2026, West Ada’s calendar hub linked the 2027–28 K–12 Student Calendar but did not list separate 2027–28 ECSE preschool, high school A/B, or middle school A/B files.

For that reason, this page does not carry forward preschool attendance rules or A/B rotations from 2026–27. Families should check the district calendar hub for additional 2027–28 files as they are published.

customSections.label: West Ada 2027–28 Grading Periods
customSections.content: The K–12 Student Calendar divides the year into four quarters.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: The first day moves from August 12 to August 11. The reviewed 2027–28 PDF does not identify the first day as a late-start day.
Thanksgiving Break moves to November 22–26, and Spring Break moves to March 13–17.
The April no-school date moves to April 14 and is specifically labeled a Working Calendar Adjustment.
Seniors finish May 12, and the districtwide last day moves to May 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When does West Ada start school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day is Wednesday, August 11, 2027. The reviewed 2027–28 PDF does not identify it as a late-start day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is West Ada Winter Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. The official PDF appears to contain an ending-year typo; its January 3 teacher prep day and January 4 school-resume date indicate that December 31, 2027 is the internally consistent end date.

calendarFaqs.q: Do West Ada high school students have September 24 or October 7 off?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar does not list grades 9–12 as off September 24. On October 7, grades K–8 have no school for conferences, while grades 9–12 remain in session and hold evening conferences.

calendarFaqs.q: When is West Ada Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 13–17, 2028, and classes resume Monday, March 20.
West Ada labels April 14 a Working Calendar Adjustment and lists no school for all grades.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for West Ada seniors?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors finish Friday, May 12, 2028. The districtwide last day of school is Thursday, May 18.
